body.x: Smartreum BangE will participate in the world’s largest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 to showcase its shoe drying sterilizer.

An official said, "Smartreum BangE is a compound word of smart and slackoff, and we are trying to solve the inconvenience that we feel in our daily lives with the slogan that laziness of customers is the driving force of innovation."

He continued and said, “We developed the 'Shoe Drying Sterilizer,' which catches germs in shoes. It is developed with the emphasis on portability for use in various environments such as home, company, travel, sports and activities, and it improves the convenience by measuring and operating the environment inside the shoe automatically. It had been awarded in various invention competitions, and it has 13 intellectual property rights, continuing the R&D activities. The product under development is the 'Shoe Drying Sterilizer for Vehicles' that incorporates IoT technology and can be conveniently used in conjunction with mobile phones and car interfaces while moving the vehicle.”

As for future plans, he said, "We are discussing with domestic and foreign buyers to meet the world's consumers and we are looking for distributors to join us. I wish everyone in the world to have a healthy and pleasant daily life with our product.”

The world’s largest IT show CES shows the trend of the global consumer electronics industry at a glance. It is hosted by Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January. AVING NEWS has reported the most news on CES, MWC, and IFA, the world's three major tech exhibitions for the past 13 years. It is sending special reporters to CES this year to report major issues in the global market and introduce outstanding Korean companies to the world.
